consequence.statement: Classic mode installations are not supported with Cilium v1.16 and are not compatible with Helm mode; they must be uninstalled with the classic mode CLI and re-installed with Cilium CLI v0.15.0 or later in Helm mode.
consequence.remediation: Uninstall Cilium using classic mode Cilium CLI, then re-install using Cilium CLI v0.15.0 or later in Helm mode.

assertion.statement: Cilium v1.16 is not supported in Cilium CLI classic installation mode; classic-mode installations must be uninstalled with the classic CLI and re-installed using Cilium CLI v0.15.0+ in Helm mode.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Whether an environment was installed with Cilium CLI classic mode is not visible in static inputs such as Helm values or manifests.
